stats.text:
As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a {ref:glossary/fly-speed} of 60 feet.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest} unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.
